purpose: A render-ready semantic plan for the opening 89.803 seconds. Every state is tied to a spoken causal turn; the plan forbids decorative overlays, unlisted wallpaper, and unsupported financial imagery.

global_edit_contract.caption_band: 0.84-0.96 frame height; never cover a hand, control, module, elevator door, or local evidence strip
global_edit_contract.generated_raster_rule: No generated numeric, ticker, date, claim, chart axis, source name, or pseudo-document text is shown.
global_edit_contract.motion_rule: A cut, trace-cut move, local card reveal, or physical state change must explain the active verb. Do not add pulses, scrolls, or camera motion merely to make a still feel active.
global_edit_contract.component_rule: The alpha components are review-only until their exact composite passes alpha-edge and semantic-fit QA. Until then, use the flattened approved plate or leave the action unresolved; never substitute generic finance art.

cues.composition: Full-frame shared ground-floor cutaway. Keep the factory basement and roof sheave legible; title lives only in the clear upper-left sky.
cues.entry_action: The red metaphor tag slides toward the crowd-supported shaft.
cues.timed_event: On the reversal word, the right cable catches a small metallic highlight; no elevator moves yet.
cues.exit_action: Hard cut on 'memory' into the skeptical reaction.
cues.approval_dependency: Flattened plate is approved; components are optional only after alpha QA.

cues.composition: Memory stack rises behind the skeptical analyst. The three built-in fact docks remain empty until the evidence phrase arrives.
cues.entry_action: The stack lifts one shallow depth step, stopping before it resembles a performance chart.
cues.timed_event: As each benchmark is spoken, its local deterministic strip locks to chip, Korea, then broad-index dock.
cues.exit_action: A local non-factual caution placard folds into the next question; it is not a generated text stamp.
cues.approval_dependency: All values are local evidence surfaces bound to the market-data packet.

cues.new_demand: default-bubble-reaction-v1: skeptical analyst pulls a plain caution placard down from a dark, chartless studio field; placard folds into a factory-door silhouette.
cues.composition: One actor, one harmless caution reflex, no performance data.
cues.timed_event: The placard creases into a question mark shape on the spoken question.
cues.exit_action: The fold becomes the factory gate in cue 004.
cues.approval_dependency: Generate before render; a plate from another cue may not fill this slot.

cues.composition: Full mechanism plate: product leaves constrained fab, bottleneck stays visible, and generic buyer commitment remains a non-factual prop.
cues.entry_action: Gate opens and one module leaves the constrained line.
cues.timed_event: At the three-support list, demand, capacity, and commitment braid into a single cable in the order narrated.
cues.exit_action: The cable points toward the index-fund inflow lane.
local_layers: claim qualifier rail: generic commitment illustration, not a named contract or guarantee
cues.approval_dependency: The flattened plate is approved; component movement remains review-only.

cues.composition: The recognizable fund container receives generic cash/share tokens; large holding tiles are visibly distinct from the long tail without naming tickers.
cues.entry_action: Tokens enter the fund container on the contribution phrase.
cues.timed_event: The top tier separates by weight as the local concentration surface appears on its dedicated dock.
cues.exit_action: Container splits into concentration and dilution paths without implying price causation.
cues.approval_dependency: The 10-tile component may only animate the named top-tier explanation after promotion.

cues.local_compositor_build: Three trace-cut deterministic risk cards: correction, overpriced, cyclical. They must remain visible through the qualification rather than being crossed out.
cues.entry_action: Cards enter one per qualifying phrase.
cues.timed_event: The prior memory cable remains behind the cards, signaling coexistence of support and risk.
cues.exit_action: Cards frame the bottleneck gate, then clear on the early-answer clause.
local_layers: plain-language qualifier labels only; no probability or price claim
cues.approval_dependency: Local vector/compositor work only; do not generate faux risk documents.

cues.composition: A queue of memory modules reaches one narrow qualification gate while demand pressure remains outside it.
cues.entry_action: Gate narrows, physically slowing the queue.
cues.timed_event: One module crosses the threshold on the phrase 'physical bottleneck'.
cues.exit_action: The outgoing cable becomes the belt leading to the default index-fund question.
local_layers: claim qualifier rail: bottleneck is an inference, not a valuation verdict
cues.approval_dependency: Flattened plate is approved; no component insertion before trace-cut review.

cues.composition: A quiet broad-index container rests on a household shelf as the inspection lamp leaves the dramatic memory scene.
cues.entry_action: Lamp crosses from left to right.
cues.timed_event: One seam opens—an invitation to inspect, not a warning of failure.
cues.exit_action: The seam becomes the diagnostic-card split.
cues.approval_dependency: Approved plate; never add danger graphics.

cues.local_compositor_build: Two-panel deterministic diagnostic: 'price up' is a symptom icon that slides aside; 'mechanism underneath' unfolds below. No numerical evidence or regulatory definition is claimed.
cues.entry_action: Symptom icon stamps into the first panel.
cues.timed_event: Underlying-mechanism panel unfolds on the correction phrase.
cues.exit_action: Panels match-cut into the two side-by-side foundations.
local_layers: two plain-language labels local to the compositor
cues.approval_dependency: Build as deterministic graphics, not generated infographic art.

cues.composition: Two equal street-level outcomes reveal their distinct support systems only as the causal distinction is narrated.
cues.entry_action: Left crowd platform makes a small human-driven lift.
cues.timed_event: Right foundation opens from the bottom upward: productive activity, scarcity gate, then generic commitment token.
cues.exit_action: Both platforms align before the closing comparison.
local_layers: support-stack labels appear only with their spoken categories; no return promise
cues.approval_dependency: Plate is approved; reusable motion parts await composite QA.

cues.composition: Return to the corrected shared-ground-floor elevator cutaway only as a deliberate closing callback, not recycled background.
cues.entry_action: Both cars rise in synchrony from the common slab.
cues.timed_event: Floor cutaway reveals the crowd support under one and roof-cable support over the other.
cues.exit_action: Cut below the floors for the next chapter's inventory of causal supports.
local_layers: one short local qualifier: same visible move, different mechanism
cues.approval_dependency: This is the sole permitted callback reuse of the elevator plate; update its catalog use limit only when the full cue sheet is resolved.
